text:
Most men have dreams. None of them have a plan. Here's why.

They confuse desire with direction. A dream is just a feeling. A plan is what imagination builds.

Most men sit with the feeling. They daydream about it. Then move on.

Real imagination asks: okay, I want this. Now what. What's first. What's next.

That act, turning desire into blueprint, that's when imagination bridges what you want with what you'll build.

Stop confusing them. One is waste. One is the game.
caption:
Your imagination shapes your success habits and discipline. Most men confuse daydreaming with planning. Send this to a man who needs it today.
